# Avianation

> Avianation is the premier aviation career board connecting pilots, mechanics, flight attendants, and aerospace professionals with opportunities across commercial airlines, charter operators, and aircraft manufacturers.

Avianation aggregates aviation job postings and career resources for the global aviation industry, including positions with major carriers like Ryanair and Virgin Atlantic, as well as specialized roles in aircraft maintenance, test piloting, and emerging electric aviation technologies. The platform serves job seekers across North America and Europe with roles ranging from entry-level to senior captain positions.
